source: t_995f6f03 live read of the signed-in NM Chrome (v3), v4 by t_4ee21e60: the code modal shows no phone, the phone is on the account

steps.text: The Thumbtack pro account for {login_email} already exists (created 2026-11-15, phone {phone}). Never use 'Sign up with email' or 'Sign up' (that makes a duplicate signup). Use the NM Chrome tab already on this setup page.

Check the session. The NM Chrome is signed in when the top bar shows Jobs, Messages, Performance, Services, Profile, Apps and https://www.thumbtack.com/login redirects to the home page. If signed out: open https://www.thumbtack.com/login, type {login_email}, fill the password from vault item {vault_item} with the vault fill helper only (never type or print it). If a CAPTCHA shows, never solve it: run the helper `fail --reason captcha` (or `session_signed_out`) with a short line of page text, then end. Signed-out path not walked yet.

Signed in, the pro setup page 'Select any other services you do' shows the service list (Marketing selected) with Back and Next. Next does NOT open the code modal: it opens the SMS consent panel “We’ll text you a verification code. Carrier rates may apply.” with a Continue button and the Terms of Use / Privacy Policy line. That Continue is the send button. After Continue, the modal 'Enter the verification code we texted you' (code expires after 10 minutes) shows four boxes #pin-input-0 to #pin-input-3, a 'Didn't get the code?' link, Back and Verify (disabled until four digits). No phone number field and no password field show: the phone is already on the account. If the page stays on 'Loading' with no code boxes, the send did not confirm: stop, never click Continue again.
steps.phone_evidence: Live read 2026-11-15 (the failed Verify Now click): the resend modal shows no phone; the account was created 2026-11-15 with the business phone.

steps.text: Send: click 'Next' on the service list (keeps Marketing). The SMS consent panel opens (“We’ll text you a verification code”); click its 'Continue' ONCE. That click is the send. Do not click 'Didn't get the code?' or any other send option after it. Run the helper `watch` right after the click, then read the page: the four code boxes must show and no error. If the code modal is already showing before you start (an earlier code was sent), click 'Didn't get the code?' instead. Then run the helper `sent` command with the page text as evidence, wait for the client's code with `code`, type it into the four boxes and click Verify.

Signup-form notes (page reference only, not used on the sign-in path): the two SMS boxes are signup-form__enable-sms-notifications-checkbox and signup-form__enable-sms-marketing-notifications-checkbox. Only the first (sms-notifications) defaults checked; the marketing box defaults unchecked. The email modal needs a second 'Sign up with email' click before the phone and password fields show.
